project_type: Python quantitative research pipeline - hypothesis generation, statistical testing, walk-forward validation, and strategy design
build_system: uv for dependency management, pyproject.toml for project metadata
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv sync to install dependencies. 2. Run uv run pytest tests/ -v to verify tests pass. 3. Run uv run python -m quant_research.main to execute the full pipeline.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Pipeline generates output reports in results/ directory (not checked in). No snapshot files.
setup_instructions: 1. pyenv local 3.11.15. 2. uv init (already done via pyproject.toml). 3. uv sync to install all deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to yfinance API for NASDAQ data download. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. uv available for package management.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establishing conventions. Use type hints, docstrings, and modular architecture.
key_patterns: Modular pipeline: data fetching -> hypothesis generation -> statistical testing -> validation -> strategy design -> robustness testing. Each module is independent and testable.
directory_structure: src/quant_research/ - main package with submodules: data/, hypotheses/, testing/, validation/, strategy/, robustness/, reporting/. tests/ - pytest test suite. results/ - generated output (gitignored).
